newsitem.title: UK: European jet fuel gains on futures' strength.
newsitem.headline: European jet fuel gains on futures' strength.

text.p: European jet fuel was tugged higher on Monday by firmer IPE gas oil futures and firm premiums.
Traders said material was tight for April, but that supplies were much improved for May. Demand for material in both NWE and the Med was fairly flat, they said.
May IPE gas oil closed $2.25 a tonne stronger at $165.50, bolstered by colder weather in the U.S.
Barges in NWE were steady at May IPE +$18 fob ARA with cargoes pegged around May IPE +$23-25 cif.
"I think +$25 is at the upper end," said one trader.
The Med was thought to have eased slightly although sellers of EU grade were still looking for fob high quotes +$10-11. Traders said some of the Libyan May programme has been announced.
